items.definition:
made by hand, not by machine
She sells beautiful handmade jewelry.

situated in or relating to the northeast
The storm is moving towards the northeastern states.

relating to the southwest
They live in the southwestern part of the country.

not used
The old bicycle sat unused in the garage.

comfortable
This sofa is really comfy.

bent or twisted out of shape or out of place
The picture on the wall was crooked.

fit or suitable to be eaten
Are these mushrooms edible?

extremely large
They built a gigantic statue in the city center.

not active; not doing anything
The volcano has been inactive for centuries.

not moving; fixed
The car remained stationary at the red light.

not able to be used or obtained; not at hand
The product is currently unavailable.

slightly wet
The clothes are still a bit damp, so don't put them away yet.

not brightly lit
The light in the room was very dim.

not defeated; having won every game or contest
The team remained undefeated throughout the season.

covered with rust; out of practice
My French is a bit rusty.

not seen or noticed
The unseen forces were at work behind the scenes.

able to be changed to suit particular needs
The chair has an adjustable height.

not paying enough attention or not thinking about what you are doing
It was careless of him to leave the door unlocked.

causing laughter and amusement; funny
He told a very humorous story.

unable to rest or relax as a result of anxiety or boredom
The children became restless during the long car journey.

able to return to its original shape or size after being stretched or squeezed
The waistband of these trousers is very elastic.

Relating to the Kurds or their language.
She is studying the Kurdish language.

Friendly and sociable; leaving a place.
She has a very outgoing personality.

gracefully thin
She had a slender figure.

(of a disease) spread from one person or organism to another by direct or indirect contact
The flu is a highly contagious illness.

feeling or showing fear or anxiety
The child was fearful of the dark.

relating to a festival, especially Christmas
The town was decorated with festive lights for the holidays.

tolerant
She is very tolerant of other people's opinions.

youthful
Despite her age, she has a very youthful appearance.

designed to be thrown away after use
We use disposable plates for picnics to make cleanup easier.

silly; ridiculous
He has a goofy sense of humor.

not costing a lot of money; cheap
We found an inexpensive restaurant for dinner.

from Jamaica
She loves Jamaican music.

happy and cheerful
He was a jolly old man who always told jokes.

from Kenya
She met a Kenyan runner at the marathon.

producing poison
Some mushrooms are poisonous and should not be eaten.

acceptable or adequate
The results of the experiment were satisfactory.

enlarged by swelling
Her ankle was swollen after the fall.

covered with fur
The cat has soft, furry paws.

containing repetition, especially when tedious or uninteresting
The work was very repetitive and boring.

covered in sweat or causing sweat
After the run, I felt hot and sweaty.

(of an animal) not wild or shy, especially because of long association with humans
The zoo has many tame animals that you can pet.

having many colors; full of variety
The market was filled with colorful fruits and vegetables.

having or showing a tendency to be quickly irritated or provoked
She grew impatient waiting for the bus.

more than one in number
The word 'cats' is the plural form of 'cat'.

not level or smooth
The road was uneven and bumpy.

impervious to water
I need a waterproof jacket for the rain.

covered with or consisting of ice; very cold
The roads were icy after the overnight freeze.

relating to or resembling a robot
His movements were stiff and robotic.

relating to Arabia or Arabs
The Arabian Desert is vast and beautiful.

light or reduced in calories, fat, etc.
I prefer the diet soda; it's a lite version.

extremely good or wonderful
She had a marvelous time at the party.

deprived of feeling or responsiveness
My fingers went numb from the cold.

fond of fun and games; lighthearted
The puppy was very playful and loved to chase its tail.

eerie, frightening
The old abandoned house looked really spooky at night.

neat and orderly
Please keep your room tidy.

able to be used
Is this old equipment still usable?

speaking two languages fluently
She is bilingual in English and Spanish.

not truthful or trustworthy
It was dishonest of him to lie about what happened.

feeling uncertain about something
It's doubtful that he will arrive on time.

able to speak or write a language easily
She is fluent in three languages.

relating to water that is not salty
This lake is home to many freshwater fish.

directed toward the outside
Her outward appearance was calm, but inside she was nervous.

not suitable or good enough; not in good physical condition
He was declared medically unfit for military service.
